page: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the EADSv5 family, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor with 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs, running at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 672.0 GB of memory, providing 7.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 3686 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. The CPU cache configuration consists of 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. It supports AVX, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, and FMA instructions, though it lacks AVX-512 support.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution and encryption, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 129,546.26 and a PassMark encryption score of 102,892.71, both placing in the top 10% of tested servers. Memory performance is highlighted by a top-tier PassMark memory score of 3,059.57 and strong cached small-block read bandwidth of 6,081.25 GB/sec. However, uncached large-block read and write bandwidths drop to average levels at 124.52 GB/sec and 63.74 GB/sec respectively. Single-core performance is strong but not top-tier, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2,881.18 and average text processing and single-threaded compression speeds.

With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial 3.6 TB local storage, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive and database workloads that require high resource density without the expense of dedicated GPU hardware. It is highly capable for multi-threaded decompression, database operations, and Redis deployments, as demonstrated by 92.17 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks. It also supports moderate LLM inference workloads, processing 3,450.23 tokens per second on small models, though performance scales down to average levels on larger 70B models.
description: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v5 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server from the EADSv5 family, powered by a dedicated 48-core AMD EPYC 7763 processor with 96 vCPUs running at 3.7 GHz. It features 672.0 GB of RAM and 3686 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capabilities. In benchmarks, the server delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance and encryption capabilities, alongside strong database operations and Redis throughput. However, large-block uncached memory bandwidth and single-core processing speeds remain average. Lacking GPU acceleration and AVX-512 support, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for high-density memory workloads, large-scale database operations, multi-threaded decompression, and small-to-medium scale LLM inference tasks.
